subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom given below:
“Throw your hat in the ring”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Announce one's candidacy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Throw your hat in the ring"** means to announce one's intention to enter a competition or contest, especially in the context of political candidacy. (चुनाव या प्रतियोगिता में शामिल होने की घोषणा करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** After months of speculation, she finally threw her hat in the ring for the mayoral race.
 
 
 
• In this context, the idiom signifies **participation** or **declaring oneself as a candidate**, as opposed to challenging authority or leaving the competition.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Announce one's candidacy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Challenge authority** (प्राधिकरण को चुनौती देना): To go against or question an established rule or person in power.
 
 
• **Example:** The workers decided to challenge the authority of their manager regarding unfair work practices.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Leave the competition** (प्रतियोगिता छोड़ देना): To withdraw or quit from a contest or race.
 
 
• **Example:** He left the competition after realizing he couldn't win against stronger opponents.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: Support a rival** (प्रतिद्वंद्वी का समर्थन करना): To endorse or back someone who is competing against you or your team.
 
 
• **Example:** Surprisingly, she decided to support her rival in the final round of the debate.
